historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly keeps the physical flash operator-owned and adds an OOB check, but does not bind the image to the SPI layout, verify the loaded byte count or address `saveenv` persistence and command-line credential exposure.

original_test_intent: Demonstrate that a board-compatible BMC image can be transferred through BMC U-Boot/TFTP, written to the intended SPI flash region, rebooted, and returned to normal out-of-band management operation on the intended firmware.
original_method: Identify the exact SUT/BMC/SPI target and active/recovery layout; back up required flash/environment/configuration data; verify the approved image, signature/hash, byte length and RAM load address; attach UART and stable recovery power; let a qualified operator execute the source TFTP, probe and approved bounded write once; avoid persisting temporary network variables unless explicitly required; reset and verify firmware identity, boot mode, management services, network/configuration, sensors, inventory and logs against the baseline.
manual_activity: A qualified operator attaches UART, interrupts BMC boot, confirms the exact SPI device, performs the single approved U-Boot write/reset and retains recovery control; the agent may validate artifacts/transcript and collect secure post-flash OOB evidence.
required_inputs: SUT, board revision, BMC/SoC and SPI bus/chip-select/JEDEC identity with complete flash-region map
Approved BMC binary filename, target version, exact byte length, hash/signature and board/bootloader compatibility
Approved RAM load address, flash offset/length and policy for preserving bootloader, environment, recovery, calibration and configuration regions
TFTP network plan, UART settings, stable power/maintenance window and qualified operator
Full backup, golden image, dual-bank or external programmer recovery procedure and maximum reboot/recovery timeout
Secure BMC credential injection and expected post-flash firmware, active bank, network/configuration, service, sensor and log oracle
safety_requirements: Verify image identity, signature/hash, transferred `$filesize`, RAM bounds, SPI JEDEC identity/capacity and approved offset/length before any write
Do not assume the literal 0x4000000 length matches the image or safe target region; never write beyond transferred bytes or approved layout
Back up all required flash/environment/configuration regions and prove an independent recovery path before starting
Use stable power and continuous UART; do not interrupt the write, reset early or retry automatically after any uncertain state
Do not run `saveenv` merely to persist temporary TFTP/DHCP variables; preserve or restore the approved environment and management network
Do not expose BMC passwords through command arguments or logs; use the approved secure credential mechanism
Stop on identity/hash/filesize/probe/capacity mismatch, transfer or write error, unexpected region change, rollback/recovery mode, firmware mismatch or loss of management access
agent_execution_scope: Validate the approved image metadata, hash/signature, size, target mapping, backup and recovery readiness
Capture and inspect the operator's UART/TFTP/SPI transcript, byte counts and post-reset timeline
Collect approved secure OOB firmware, bank, service, network, configuration, sensor, inventory and event-log evidence after recovery
Do not manipulate UART, execute the SPI write/reset, infer a safe image length/layout, reveal credentials, retry a failed flash or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve the exact image, hash, board compatibility, RAM address, SPI device, offset, byte count and regions that may change
Decide whether `saveenv` is required and define expected retained/restored U-Boot and BMC network configuration
Approve backup, stable-power, timeout, golden/external recovery and no-retry policy
Review full write/verify and post-flash health evidence and issue the DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The operator split and post-flash `mc info` are directionally correct, but a version-only check cannot prove the exact SPI target/length, boot-bank activation, configuration preservation or general BMC health; `-P` also exposes the password in process arguments.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval, preserve the source UART sequence but compare the TFTP-reported `$filesize` with the signed image and approved region, identify SPI JEDEC/capacity, write only the approved bytes, verify written content if supported, omit/justify `saveenv`, and use a secure credential mechanism for full post-flash OOB health checks.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC UART, TFTP to 0x83000000, `sf probe 0`, source write offset zero and stated 0x4000000 length as an approval subject, reset, BMC-function check, Common branch and 15/30-minute estimate are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run one identity-bound, byte-count-bounded U-Boot SPI transaction under operator control, then prove target firmware activation and complete BMC functional/configuration recovery with preserved evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable image/target identity, transfer-size and SPI-capacity checks, backup/non-target protection, environment-side-effect control, secure credential handling and a broader post-flash oracle without replacing the source mechanism.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful `sf update` or a responding `mc info` alone does not prove that the intended image/region was written, that the correct bank activated, or that network/configuration, sensors, logs and recovery regions remain valid.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong or partial offset-zero write can brick the BMC and remove out-of-band recovery; the source's fixed 64 MiB length may exceed the transferred image or include board-specific protected content.

project_override_considerations: Project firmware packages may legitimately define a full 64 MiB image and `saveenv` behavior, but those facts must come from the approved board-specific package/layout; they cannot be inferred from the generic source row.
expected_evidence: SUT/board/BMC identity, SPI bus/chip-select/JEDEC ID/capacity and approved region map
Pre-flash firmware, bank, environment/network/configuration, services, sensors, inventory, SEL and required full-flash backups
Continuous UART transcript showing TFTP address and exact byte count, SPI probe identity, approved write offset/length, result/verification and reset
Post-flash firmware version/build and active-bank evidence plus boot/recovery-mode status and management reachability timeline
Secure IPMI/Redfish/WebUI service, network/configuration, sensor, inventory, SEL/log and non-target-region preservation evidence
Recovery action if needed, final configuration/power state and engineer PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row144 Wistron-HW Robust-00022-V002: approve the exact SUT/board/BMC and SPI bus/chip-select/JEDEC/capacity/region map; signed BMC image filename/version/hash/byte length and RAM address; whether offset0 length0x4000000 is exactly safe or must use verified `$filesize`; which bootloader/environment/recovery/calibration/configuration regions may change; whether `saveenv` is required and expected network-variable restoration; full backup, stable-power, timeout, golden/external recovery and secure post-flash firmware/bank/service/configuration/sensor/log oracle.

review_improvement: Preserves the source's operator U-Boot flash while converting an unbounded fixed-length critical write into an identity-bound, size-verified and recoverable transaction with configuration and full BMC-health proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: `tftp` reports an actual transfer byte count, whereas `sf update ... 0x4000000` always consumes 64 MiB from RAM. If the binary is shorter, trailing RAM contents can be written; if the board's SPI map differs, an offset-zero full-span write can overwrite U-Boot, environment, recovery or board data. `sf probe 0` also proves only that some device was selected unless JEDEC identity/capacity are matched. Finally, `saveenv` after setting `serverip` and using DHCP can persist temporary lab networking. Therefore the review must bind every destructive parameter to a signed board package, control environment persistence and retain independent recovery, while a responding BMC remains evidence rather than an automatic PASS.
